_comment: Hand-computed n-step fixtures (gamma = 1/2).  Every expected number below was derived by hand from the definition G = sum_{i<h} gamma^i r_i + gamma^h Q_target(s_h, argmax_a Q_online(s_h, a)) (no bootstrap after a true terminal, bootstrap from the real final observation after a time-limit truncation), not produced by running any pipeline.  A step is [state, action, reward, next_state, status] with status '' | 'terminated' | 'truncated'; a sample is [state, action, return, disc, next_state, y_double, y_max_target].  The online argmax is action 0 at every bootstrap state, the target network values another action higher, so Double DQN and plain max-target differ.
